info.name: Social Media Posts API — Facebook & Instagram
info.description:
Unified Facebook & Instagram Posts API acceptance suite.

Top-level folders:
1. 01 — Facebook
2. 02 — Instagram

Safety:
- Offline Resilience subfolders require fakeUpstreamUrl (npm run postman:offline).
- Prefer `npm run postman:serve` (cache-only) for Desktop inspection.
- Real Posts may cost Apify credits if cache is cold — do not Run Collection blindly.
- Default env accounts: Qasioun Journey Facebook + Instagram.
- Never put APIFY_TOKEN in Postman.
